name: clawd-panel
description: A right-side HUD pane for Claude Code: usage, context breakdown, subagents, git and a pixel-art avatar.

title.title: HUD title
title.description: The name drawn at the top of the pane.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: pyra draws the dark board of the design; pyra-light suits a light terminal.

alertThreshold.title: Context alert threshold (%)
alertThreshold.description: At or above this context fill the meters turn inverse red and a toast shows once per crossing.

dockColumns.title: Docked pane width
dockColumns.description: Columns the pane asks for when docked beside the transcript.
